body.text: For anyone working long shifts – this is the sleep upgrade that actually helped. I was waking up foggy and running on empty no matter how much I slept. Turns out my breathing was the problem. This mouthpiece keeps your airway open overnight. Clearheaded mornings. Less draining shifts. Feeling put together starts with actually recovering the night before.

snapshot.caption: airwaav.com

cards.body:
Most people blame their mattress, their schedule, or their stress. But if you're waking up tired, foggy, or sore – your breathing at night is likely the real reason.

When you sleep, your tongue relaxes and can fall back, narrowing your airway and disrupting the deep, restorative stages of sleep your body needs to recover.

The AIRWAAV RX1 fixes that. Using patented Reflex Technology, it gently keeps your tongue forward so your airway stays open all night – no jaw-pushing, no bulky devices, no pills.

The result? Deeper sleep. Fewer wake-ups. More energy, better recovery, and mornings that actually feel like rest.
✅ No jaw repositioning
✅ Works for men and women
✅ HSA/FSA eligible
✅ Backed by 15+ years of research

Loved by 300,000+ customers. Try it risk-free for 30 days.
